high_impact_watchlist.topic: US weekly initial jobless claims / labor-market data ahead of payrolls
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Labor softness pulls forward Fed cut pricing, lowers front-end real yields and DXY, supporting gold
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Large surprise versus consensus or a multi-week trend break that shifts rate-cut odds

high_impact_watchlist.topic: Fed speakers / FOMC communication and rate-path repricing
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Gold is a zero-coupon asset; shifts in expected policy path move real yields directly
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Voting members explicitly changing tone on cuts/hikes or balance-sheet policy

high_impact_watchlist.topic: 10Y real yield (TIPS) and nominal curve moves
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Real yield is the core opportunity-cost input for gold valuation
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Fast intraday moves in TIPS yields, especially disorderly bear steepening or sharp bull flattening

high_impact_watchlist.topic: DXY / major FX moves (JPY, EUR, CNY fix)
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Dollar is the pricing numeraire; weaker DXY mechanically lifts XAUUSD and boosts non-US demand
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Broad, sustained dollar move rather than a narrow single-pair drift

high_impact_watchlist.topic: Treasury supply: coupon auctions, TGA rebuild and bill issuance
high_impact_watchlist.why_gold_cares: Weak auction demand pressures term premium and can hit both bonds and dollar confidence; TGA rebuild drains liquidity
high_impact_watchlist.impact_threshold: Tailing auctions, weak indirect bids, or unusually rapid cash-balance rebuild

ranked_data_influence.verdict: Fresh catalysts matter when source, freshness, and transmission mechanism are clear.
RSI/MAs/candle momentum are now scored as a normalized tensor for entry timing and confirmation.
Price movement is the final arbiter for whether the prior thesis transmitted.
Dollar moves usually matter when the intraday change is large enough to transmit to gold.
Real yields are high-impact for gold when they change materially, but daily FRED data can be stale intraday.

low_or_no_weight_data.verdict: Useful macro context, but usually lower intraday weight unless the liquidity shift is large.

loopback_evaluation.scoring_feedback: Increase weight on the highest-ranked data types only when they aligned with the actual XAUUSD spot move; reduce weight on failed, stale, or non-transmitting inputs.

top_disruptive_events.title: US Q2 prelim unit labor costs +1.3% vs +2.1% expected
top_disruptive_events.description: Prior was 2.3% Productivity +1.4% vs +0.6% expected Prior productivity was +0.8% This isn't really a useful report because productivity is so hard to measure and it's often revised many times. In theory, unit labor costs are a critical inflation number but it's rarely a market mover because measuring it is so variable quarter-to-quarter. The dollar has much bigger questions to answer at the moment with all the intervention in the yen. The Treasury market also doesn't like what it's been hearing
top_disruptive_events.claude_impact_reason: Softer unit labor costs with stronger productivity is a mildly disinflationary combination, marginally supportive of cut pricing and gold; more notable is the embedded flag of heavy yen intervention and an unsettled Treasury market, which is a dollar-confidence/liquidity channel worth monitoring.
top_disruptive_events.historical_impact_basis: Productivity/ULC is rarely a standalone gold mover due to revision noise, but FX-intervention and Treasury-stress backdrops have historically transmitted to gold via dollar and term-premium channels.
